text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, fight on!!
You can pull away at the front!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
Sato-chan, right now!!
Surge from behind, make your pass!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The excitement is incredible. It seems
Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black are facing off
in an informal match race, but――

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *huff*...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaall right!!
This one's my win, Dia-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, out of three runs, two losses, huh... Kita-chan,
you've been getting faster and faster lately.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you think so?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But on that very first run, you caught right up
and passed me, so――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I gotta sharpen my focus even more!
I'm headed to the library to look up mental training methods!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for running with me today, Dia-chan!
Catch ya later!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeah... See you later, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ............Right. I have to go too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, later that night.
Noticing the lights in the gym were on late, I went to check――
*phew*... *huff*...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry. Is it lights-out already?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's still time before lights-out.
However, it's already quite late, so she's the only one left in the gym...
choice_data_list: There's still time, but aren't you pushing yourself too hard?
Still got time, but aren't you overworking yourself?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My... you are very kind.
But Dia is perfectly fine!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I stop at this level... I will never
be able to overtake my rival.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about Kitasan Black?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Kita-chan was the first.
The first one to make me think, 'She is stronger than me.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I always believed that just looking ahead was enough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: To fulfill the purpose of my birth, to answer everyone's expectations... I only looked straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But――

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan appeared right in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In my field of vision, which had always been blank and clear,
her presence was reflected for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That is why I want to overtake Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Straightforward, warm, running ahead of me.
Because she is so strong... I absolutely want to surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's ironclad determination came through clearer than ever.
Here, I should――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her I would let her know when it was lights-out,
and encouraged her to focus on training as much as she wished until then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Is that alright?
...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Alright.
I have to keep giving it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after Satono Diamond returned to her training――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...My?
Is someone already using the leg press machine...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *huff*...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It appears I should make my retreat for today, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for quite a while after that, Satono Diamond remained
single-mindedly focused without looking aside once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I was leaving, I simply reminded her
to be careful not to stay up too late.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will keep close track of the time.
Thank you very much for your consideration!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, just as I thought to head back, I heard voices coming from the track,
so I went over to check――

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... *whew*!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Stay conscious of the focal point... yeah.
I feel like I'm getting the hang of it...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Alright, one more lap!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was a moment that made me look forward
to the future these two will race toward together.
